item.name: SCIM User Sync V3

description.content: SCIM 2.0 compliant user sync APIs version 3.

item.name: Return list of users based on the filter condition.

request.name: Return list of users based on the filter condition.

description.content:
Search/retrieve users based on the filter string parameter. Please be cautious if you are using organization token, search API will return users of all associated companies of parent company's org id if company is not provided in the filter criteria.

Results are returned in ascending order of userIds.

Note: We only support search by email, name, userName and singleSignOnId. Since filter attribute contains special characters like square brackets, clients need to encode the filter attribute value.

    
        For search by email with value as test@egencia.com, you need to pass encoded value in filter which will be :
        filter = emails%5Bvalue%20eq%20%22test%40egencia.com%22%5D
        which is the encoded value for filter = emails[value eq "test@egencia.com"]

query.description: SCIM compliant filter attribute to take query string. If you are using any external tool to make the API call, please make sure to encode the filter value.
Number of resources to be returned. Maximum supported value is 100

response.name: Search api success.
